verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's own pages name most of the menu: H-1B, O-1, TN and 'E' work visas, plus green-card paths (NIW, PERM, immigrant petitions). It also offers path-selection guidance and explicitly lists founders as clients. However, the temporary-visa material is framed for employers, H-1B coverage addresses only the annual cap and lottery, and E-2 is never named specifically. Missing for 10: cap-exempt H-1B routes, explicit E-2 treeaty-investor coverage, founder-specific comparative guidance across visa types, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation

citations.quote: We help employers secure H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E, and other work visas, providing clear strategy, careful preparation, and steady communication.
We guide employers through the annual cap, lottery selection process, and critical filing timelines so hiring plans stay on track.
We guide employers through green card strategy, PERM, and immigrant petitions with clarity and care.
The National Interest Waiver lets you petition for a green card on your own when your work serves the national interest of the United States.
Not sure which path fits your background? We help you understand your options and choose the strategy that best showcases your achievements.
Ellis Porter helps researchers, founders, physicians, engineers, artists, and other exceptional professionals build a clear path to living and working in the United States.
